scope: Private isolated probe; no main manuscript changes, refitting, new policy optimization, or policy selection from evaluation answers.
exact_definition: For each model, upper regret=max(0, all directed pair upper bounds); certified iff upper regret<=epsilon. Strict winner checked separately with all directed bounds<0.

bootstrap.method: Descriptive synchronized seven-day circular calendar-block percentile bootstrap,2000 draws, within each source; all intraday blocks and systems share day indices.
bootstrap.interpretation: Repeated blocks are not independent systems; no population inference or threshold optimization.
